summary: Mobile-only frontend E2E on Expo web preview. Seeded session_token for seed_marina in localStorage and mobile-viewport (428x920) tested. App is NOT blank — landing renders with google-signin-btn. HOWEVER, the deployed Expo web preview cannot make any authenticated API calls due to a preview-infra CORS Origin-rewrite (see rca). To validate app behavior I intercepted /api/** via Playwright route.fetch and confirmed EVERY flow works at the code level: Feed (6 posts, notifications-btn, new-post-fab), Post detail (comment posted & visible), Notifications page, /new-post (publish-post-btn), Events (10 cards, 11 market chips incl market-chip-all), Event detail (rsvp-attendee-btn toggles, join-crew-btn present for premium user), /new-event (create-event-submit-btn), Directory tab (labelled 'Boat Pros', 4 pro-card-<id>, directory-search-input), Pro detail (star-3 + submit-review-btn + message-pro-btn), Messages (2 seeded threads), Chat (chat-input + chat-send-btn — 'TEST ws hello' appeared, WS working), Profile (edit-handle-row → save-handle-btn, newsletter-switch, manage-pro-btn → /pro-edit → save-pro-btn, logout-button), Pricing (Test mode banner, 9 subscribe buttons for boat_pro packages, subscribe click POSTs /api/payments/checkout). Bundle compiles cleanly, no runtime console errors — only a benign 'shadow*' RN-Web deprecation warning.

integration_issues.flow: All authenticated flows on Expo web preview
integration_issues.issue: Browser fetches to https://owsa-events-preview--7evdsk8f.preview.emergentagent.com/api/* are blocked by CORS. The CDN/ingress rewrites the request Origin from 'https://boat-community.expo.preview.emergentagent.com' to 'https://boat-community.cluster-7.preview.emergentcf.cloud' before it reaches FastAPI; FastAPI (allow_origin_regex='.*') correctly echoes that rewritten origin, but the BROWSER rejects because Access-Control-Allow-Origin doesn't match its real Origin. Net effect: /auth/me fails on cold load → user stays stuck on landing screen even with a valid session_token seeded in localStorage. Only reproducible via a real browser at the .expo.preview URL; curl works. Verified: OPTIONS with Origin foo.example.com → echoed correctly; OPTIONS with the expo.preview origin → echoes cluster-7 URL. All 5 tabs and every downstream flow are functional when the CORS layer is bypassed via a Playwright route-fetch proxy.

After tapping star-3 then submit-review-btn on /directory/seed_rigging the API accepts the review (no error) but the page shows no visible success toast/confirmation text — user has no feedback that the review was submitted. Minor UX gap.

issues: Directory tab label is 'Boat Pros' in the tab bar while the requirements/testIDs use 'directory-*'. Not a bug, but tab label and route name diverge — flag for consistency.

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web deprecation warning in console: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Emitted multiple times on landing and on tabs — likely from Button/Card in /app/mobile/src/components/ui/*. Non-blocking but should be migrated to boxShadow for future RN-Web compatibility.

action_items: CRITICAL / INFRA: Investigate why the Cloudflare/ingress edge rewrites the request Origin header from 'https://boat-community.expo.preview.emergentagent.com' to 'https://boat-community.cluster-7.preview.emergentcf.cloud' when proxying preview traffic to the FastAPI backend. Without fixing this, the mobile Expo WEB preview is effectively unusable for authenticated flows. Workarounds if the edge rewrite cannot be changed: (a) also serve the API from a same-origin path under the Expo preview host (e.g. proxy /api/** on the expo.preview domain to the FastAPI service — this is what web/frontend already gets), or (b) hardcode Access-Control-Allow-Origin to a wildcard string without credentials mode when the app doesn't need cookies (mobile uses Bearer tokens, so allow_credentials could be false and allow_origins='*' would satisfy browsers). Native production builds are NOT affected.
Show a success toast/inline confirmation on /directory/[id] after submit-review-btn (currently silent).
Migrate remaining 'shadow*' RN styles to 'boxShadow' to clear the RN-Web deprecation warning.
Optional: rename the (tabs) route/label to keep 'Directory' consistent with the testID prefix (directory-search-input, directory-*), or update copy accordingly.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py CORS: allow_origin_regex='.*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically fine, but only if the client's actual Origin reaches Starlette. With the current CDN rewrite it does not. Because mobile uses Bearer tokens (not cookies), consider a separate CORS stanza for /api that uses allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=False — this bypasses the browser's credentials+wildcard rejection and is safe for a Bearer-only mobile client.

mobile AuthContext: /auth/me failure on cold load silently falls through to null user with no visible error surfacing. A retry/backoff + a small 'Can't reach server' banner would make CORS/network faults obvious to future testers instead of appearing as a mysterious 'stuck on landing' bug.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Expo web preview at https://boat-community.expo.preview.emergentagent.com CANNOT complete /api/* calls from a real browser because the ingress rewrites the Origin header (see rca of the issue). To verify mobile flows end-to-end via Playwright, seed the token in localStorage AND intercept 'https://owsa-events-preview--7evdsk8f.preview.emergentagent.com/api/**' with route.fetch (proxy from server side, add Access-Control-Allow-Origin:*). Script pattern in this run works. Every code-level flow (Feed, Post, Notifications, New Post, Events, Event detail RSVP + join-crew, New Event, Directory, Pro detail review/message, Messages+WS chat, Profile edit-handle/newsletter/manage-pro, Pro Edit, Pricing subscribe -> /api/payments/checkout) is functional and has correct testIDs — no code-side bugs found beyond a silent review submit toast and a shadow-style deprecation warning.
rca of the issue: Repro (browser): 1) open https://boat-community.expo.preview.emergentagent.com with devtools; 2) observe Console: 'Access to fetch at https://owsa-events-preview--7evdsk8f.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/me from origin https://boat-community.expo.preview.emergentagent.com has been blocked by CORS policy'. Repro (curl, proves it's an edge rewrite not FastAPI): `curl -X OPTIONS -H 'Origin: https://boat-community.expo.preview.emergentagent.com' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: GET' https://owsa-events-preview--7evdsk8f.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/me -D-` returns `access-control-allow-origin: https://boat-community.cluster-7.preview.emergentcf.cloud`. Same curl with `-H 'Origin: https://foo.example.com'` returns `access-control-allow-origin: https://foo.example.com`. => FastAPI's `allow_origin_regex='.*'` is working; the edge (Cloudflare/ingress) is rewriting incoming Origin headers only for the .expo.preview host to a .cluster-7.preview.emergentcf.cloud host, so the value FastAPI reflects back never matches what the browser sent. Mitigation options: (a) fix the edge rewrite rule for the .expo.preview host; (b) reverse-proxy /api under the .expo.preview origin (same-origin, no CORS); (c) drop credentials on /api CORS and return literal `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` since mobile uses Bearer tokens, not cookies.
